gen-dafont-starborn-gf-gafata: Starborn scatters its letters across wide stretches of blank space, with a dark stripe of lowercase running through every line. Gafata, a plain sans, stands tall and tidy underneath.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-geist: Dreamy and ethereal, Starborn lets its letters drift apart with a heavy band of lowercase. Geist is the one that holds the line, its words packing into solid blocks with a level beat.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-georama: Starborn leaves huge gaps of blank space between its letters, then lays a thick, dark stripe of lowercase through each line. Georama, in sans-serif dress, keeps its capitals low and its c wide open.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-gidole: Ethereal is the first word that fits Starborn, with its big pockets of space between letters. Gidole, the sans-serif below, holds a neon-tube consistency and keeps its terminals apart like open scissor blades.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-golos-text: Golos Text reads big and approachable, its x-height filling the line and its s parted wide. Starborn does the dreamy, spaced-out showing off, while the sans does the steady, solid work.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-hedvig-letters-sa: Dreamy spacing runs through Starborn, whose thick, dark lowercase stripe cuts across every line. Hedvig Letters Sans then carries on easily, its small letters standing almost as tall as capitals.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-heebo: Spacey and soft-edged, Starborn spreads out its letters with a thick, dark stripe of lowercase in every line. Heebo, a sans-serif, keeps a tall central band that would read smoothly for pages.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-hind-guntur: Hind Guntur reads like stamped metal type, tall in the lowercase with wide gaps where curves meet stems. Over many pages it would feel sturdy and unhurried, a plain sans with rod-stock strokes.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-hind-madurai: Hind Madurai fills the line with lowercase that stands up like capitals, its s curves open wide at both ends. Starborn is the dreamy one, all drifting space, while Hind Madurai is the sans that gets on with the text.
gen-dafont-starborn-gf-hind-mysuru: Ethereal and dreamy, Starborn lets its letters float apart, with a thick, dark band of lowercase through every line. Hind Mysuru, a sans-serif, would carry a long read with its tall tops and half-open a.
